findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_posture, dshield_ip_check, disclosure_contacts, robots_sitemap, wayback_snapshot, urlscan_lookup, dkim_lookup, wayback_urls, blacklist_check, caa_dnssec · Private data: dns_propagation, email_posture, dmarc_check, tranco_rank, cve_lookup, dns_lookup, abuse_contact, disclosure_contacts, rdap, robots_sitemap, passive_dns, ip_blocklist_check, spf_expand, spf_check, zone_transfer_check, urlscan_lookup, dkim_lookup, wayback_urls, blacklist_check, asn_geoip, security_txt, caa_dnssec · Public sink: email_header_analyzer, email_posture, tls_certificate, epss_score, cert_revocation, related_domains, dkim_lookup, investigate, blacklist_check · Destructive: scan_site, ip_blocklist_check, related_domains, investigate, ip_reputation_aggregate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_posture, dshield_ip_check, disclosure_contacts, robots_sitemap, wayback_snapshot, urlscan_lookup, dkim_lookup, wayback_urls, blacklist_check, caa_dnssec · Private data: dns_propagation, email_posture, dmarc_check, tranco_rank, cve_lookup, dns_lookup, abuse_contact, disclosure_contacts, rdap, robots_sitemap, passive_dns, ip_blocklist_check, spf_expand, spf_check, zone_transfer_check, urlscan_lookup, dkim_lookup, wayback_urls, blacklist_check, asn_geoip, security_txt, caa_dnssec · Public sink: email_header_analyzer, email_posture, tls_certificate, epss_score, cert_revocation, related_domains, dkim_lookup, investigate, blacklist_check · Destructive: scan_site, ip_blocklist_check, related_domains, investigate, ip_reputation_aggregate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
